presets.label: MXFP4 전체
presets.yaml:
name: qd_mxfp4
description: "Built with the Tri-Cast Quantizer demo (one method per Linear layer)."
defaults:
  weight:
    scheme: mxfp4
    mma_input: dequant
  activation:
    scheme: mxfp4
    mma_input: dequant
  transform: none
  weight_algo: rtn
exclude: [lm_head]

presets.label: MXFP4 + 첫·마지막 블록 BF16
presets.yaml:
name: qd_mxfp4_ends_bf16
description: "Built with the Tri-Cast Quantizer demo (one method per Linear layer)."
defaults:
  weight:
    scheme: mxfp4
    mma_input: dequant
  activation:
    scheme: mxfp4
    mma_input: dequant
  transform: none
  weight_algo: rtn
overrides:
  - layers: "0,27"
    skip: true
exclude: [lm_head]

presets.label: NVFP4 전체
presets.yaml:
name: qd_nvfp4
description: "Built with the Tri-Cast Quantizer demo (one method per Linear layer)."
defaults:
  weight:
    scheme: nvfp4
    mma_input: dequant

    scheme: nvfp4

presets.label: NVINT4 전체
presets.yaml:
name: qd_nvint4
description: "Built with the Tri-Cast Quantizer demo (one method per Linear layer)."
defaults:
  weight:
    scheme: nvfp4
    format: int4
    mma_input: dequant
  activation:
    scheme: nvfp4
    format: int4
    mma_input: dequant
  transform: none
  weight_algo: rtn
exclude: [lm_head]

presets.label: 혼합: AWQ+NVFP4 · GPTQ down · MXFP8 o · KIVI-2
presets.yaml:
name: qd_mixed
description: "Built with the Tri-Cast Quantizer demo (one method per Linear layer)."
defaults:
  weight:
    scheme: nvfp4
    mma_input: dequant
  activation:
    scheme: nvfp4
    mma_input: dequant
  transform:
    kind: awq
    share_inputs: true
  weight_algo: rtn
overrides:
  - layers: "0,27"
    skip: true
  - match: "*.self_attn.o_proj"
    weight:
      scheme: mxfp8_e4m3
      mma_input: dequant
    activation:
      scheme: mxfp8_e4m3
      mma_input: dequant
    transform: none
    weight_algo: rtn
  - match: "*.mlp.down_proj"
    weight: int4_g128_zp
    activation: null
    transform: none
    weight_algo: gptq
kv:
  preset: kivi2
  mode: fakequant
exclude: [lm_head]
calibration:
  seed: 42
